chunks.title: crispy🔥chicken_lollipop
chunks.text: Assalamualaikum, today we are going to make Chicken Lollipop Ramadan Special We have washed the chicken with 2 tbsp vinegar and 5-6 water You can see the chicken is white and the blood is clean Now we will add 2 tbsp of ginger garlic paste We will make the marination Ginger will be less and garlic will be more We have also taken green chillies, we will add green chillies We eat spicy, so we will add more green chillies We will add coriander leaves, it gives a good flavor We will add salt according to our taste We have added food color, if you don't want to add, you can skip it We have added Kashmiri red chilli powder, it will give a good color We will add white pepper, you can add black pepper We are adding white pepper 1 tbsp We will mix it well It will be good if you do it with your hands, I have told you in my chicken videos Those who have not subscribed to my channel, you are 65% Please subscribe to my channel If you like my recipe, please like it Add 1 tbsp of black soy sauce If you don't have it, you can skip it But if you add it, it will be very good We will add corn flour We will add 2 tbsp of corn flour So that the spices are well coated in the lollipop 2 tbsp We will add a little more The spices will be well coated and crispy We will keep it for half an hour for marination You can keep it in the fridge or in a cool place After half an hour, we will fry the chicken lollipop We have kept the oil to heat on the gas The oil should not be too hot, it should be on a medium flame We will put the lollipop in the oil I am not using a deep fry pan, I am using a shallow fry pan We will put the second batch later We will fry it after 3-4 minutes We will fry it on a medium flame If we fry it on a high flame, it will burn and it will not be fried from inside So we have to fry it on a medium flame Now we will flip it over After 2-3 minutes We have to keep it on a medium flame so that the inside is fried So that it is not raw from inside So that it does not turn over 9-10 minutes have passed Now we will take out our lollipops We will put the second batch We will fry it again after cooling it We will put it in the oil again after cooling it We will put it in the oil again after cooling it So that it becomes more crispy We will keep the flame low So that it becomes more crispy We will put it in the oil again after cooling it We will put it in the oil again after cooling it So that it becomes more crispy We will flip it over So that it does not turn over We will put it in the oil again after cooling it And those of you who have not subscribed yet, please subscribe to my channel And we will put good recipes like this Have you subscribed? Very good It will be fun to eat We will put it in the oil again After 3-4 minutes, we will take out our lollipops The oil is a little dirty, the flame is too high We will put the second batch in the same way We will put it in the oil again after 3-4 minutes We will put it in the oil again after 3-4 minutes Our lollipops are ready I have made schezwan chutney before We will serve it with it Lemon, onion, and our tasty lollipops Thank you for watching it.
